newsitem.title: USA: Wexford Technology in pact with affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Wexford Technology in pact with affiliate.

text.p: Wexford Technology Inc said Tuesday it signed an agreement with its affiliate Ridgepointe Mining Co to process ore containing platinum group metals and gold from claims located in New Mexico.
Terms of the 50-50 joint venture call for Wexford to construct its own processing facility to process the ore for the recovery of platinum group metals and gold.
Wexford said it planned to use a proprietary process called the Phoenix Process that it has licensed to recover platinum group metals and gold from the ore body.

"Although we have a considerable number of additional samples and tests to conduct, including additional pilot recovery tests, tests conducted to date are very encouraging," Jeffrey Wilson, president, said in a statement.

"Using the Phoenix Process technology, we have successfully recovered platinum group metals in commercial quantities from this ore. Subject to further successful test results, we are discussing the pre-sale of platinum at a discount with an end user of platinum group metals in order to attempt to obtain sufficient capital to build the processing facility."
